# Mindfire Digital Open Source

> Mindfire Digital's open-source projects hub — showcasing contributions, projects, packages, and community engagement in the global open-source ecosystem.

Mindfire Digital LLP is a leading provider of Software & IT services with 650+ passionate technologists. This site serves as the central hub for all open-source initiatives, project showcases, contributor recognition, and community involvement.

## Pages

- [Home](https://mindfiredigital.github.io/): Landing page with hero section and overview of open-source mission
- [About](https://mindfiredigital.github.io/about): Information about Mindfire Digital and the open-source team
- [Projects](https://mindfiredigital.github.io/projects): Complete list of open-source projects
- [Current Projects](https://mindfiredigital.github.io/current-projects): Active projects under development
- [Upcoming Projects](https://mindfiredigital.github.io/upcoming-projects): Planned future open-source projects
- [Packages](https://mindfiredigital.github.io/packages): Published npm/PyPI packages
- [Contributors](https://mindfiredigital.github.io/contributors): Recognition of community contributors
- [Issues](https://mindfiredigital.github.io/issues): Open issues available for contribution
- [Join Us](https://mindfiredigital.github.io/join-us): How to get involved and contribute

## Key Information

- Organization: Mindfire Digital LLP
- Website: https://www.mindfiresolutions.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/mindfiredigital
- Tech Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Deployment: Static export hosted on GitHub Pages
